- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_compare_graphs — Compare two indexed snapshots: deterministic target-only additions and base-only removals of stable node/edge identities; each set capped by limit and a 512 KiB budget with exact totals and truncat…

- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_get_architecture — Bounded static architecture; poll pending jobs. include_behavior_evidence=true adds indexed call arguments, parameter declarations and return types; not full dataflow or runtime traces.
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_get_code_snippet — Read a search_graph symbol. auto bounds source and outlines large containers; full restores up to 500 lines. Source/outline pages continue; coverage_note marks gaps.
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_get_file_outline — Declaration outline of one exact repository-relative file: optional exact label filter, source order, exact total/offset/limit paging; file/folder/container nodes excluded.
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_get_graph_schema — Get node-label and edge-type counts. diagnostics=full also lists queryable properties.
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_index_repository — Index a repository. full/moderate add semantics; fast omits them; cross-repo-intelligence links services. Reports coverage gaps. Waits for the whole index by default; a large repo can exceed a clie…
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_index_status — Project readiness, counts, root, watch state, coverage gaps, and doc_links (doc-comment references: MENTIONS edges, unresolved by reason). diagnostics adds coverage rows; verbose adds Git paths. Be…
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_ingest_traces — Record observed runtime calls so the graph can distinguish observed from merely possible paths. Each trace is a call path (qualified names, adjacent = caller→callee) or a bare caller/callee pair.…
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_list_projects — List projects with stable paging. Identity is lean; stats adds graph sizes.
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_manage_adr — Outline an ADR by default; get reads it; update replaces it
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_query_graph — Read-only Cypher for multi-hop, aggregation, complexity, or cross-service analysis. Default: 200 visible rows with exact/lower-bound totals and truncation; continue safely with next_cursor. graph=m…
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_search_code — Graph-ranked text search: compact symbols, full bounded source, or file paths.
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_search_graph — Find symbols via BM25 query, regex name/qn filters, or semantic_query. Rows keep qn/file/lines and in/out over CALLS/USAGE/CALL_REFERENCE/INHERITS/IMPLEMENTS.
- xd://mcp__codebase_memory_mcp_trace_path — Trace callers/callees, data flow, or cross-service paths. Defaults exclude tests and resolver evidence. Rows keep qn/hop with explicit totals, relations, and continuations.
Read `xd://<tool>` docs + JSON schema before first use; write JSON args object to `xd://<tool>` to execute.
